Through The Great Grid Upgrade, we're building the infrastructure that will connect cleaner energy sources, strengthen energy security, and power millions of homes and businesses for decades to come. We are recruiting several Head of Delivery roles. These individuals will be responsible for the development, consenting, installation, and commissioning of works associated with HV substations, HVDC converter stations, and HVAC and HVDC cables, covering both onshore and offshore activities. This is more than a job. It's an opportunity to play a defining role in shaping the future of Britain's energy system and leave a legacy that generations will benefit from. As projects enter the procurement and delivery phases, successful candidates will become key members of the project leadership team, responsible for delivering all aspects of the works. Typically, each work package will be valued at more than £1 billion. We are recruiting nationally; however, we have a particular focus on the North East, North West, and East of England, including London, due to project demands. Build and maintain a strong, open, and constructive relationship with Ofgem, ensuring the regulator is engaged throughout the project lifecycle and has a clear understanding of the challenges associated with delivering this major programme of work. Lead the identification and implementation of opportunities, alongside effective risk management, to ensure delivery of agreed outputs within the applicable regulatory framework.
